name: Analyst1 for Splunk SOAR
description: Interact with the Analyst1 API to power SOAR workflows, including indicator lookups, evidence management, and other supported Analyst1 operations.

base_url.description: Base URL with no trailing slash (e.g. https://analyst1.customer.com)

username.description: Analyst1 Username (Basic authentication for REST-enabled account)

password.description: Analyst1 Password (Basic authentication for REST-enabled account)

actions.description: Test connectivity to the Analyst1 platform.
Check for the presence of a domain in the Analyst1 platform
Check for the presence of an email in the Analyst1 platform
Check for the presence of a hash in the Analyst1 platform
Check for the presence of a string in the Analyst1 platform
Check for the presence of an IP in the Analyst1 platform
Check for the presence of an IPv6 in the Analyst1 platform
Check for the presence of a URL in the Analyst1 platform
Check for the presence of a mutex in the Analyst1 platform
Check for the presence of an HTTP request in the Analyst1 platform
Check a batch of indicator values (type auto-detected) against the Analyst1 platform

values.name: values
values.description: Comma- or newline-separated indicator values to check; the indicator type of each value is auto-detected. The combined length is limited to 6000 characters (URL length limit); split larger inputs.

actions.description: Fetch an indicator from the Analyst1 platform by its Analyst1 ID

indicator_id.name: indicator_id
indicator_id.description: Analyst1 indicator ID (hash indicator IDs may carry a type suffix, e.g. 14131-md5; the suffix is stripped)

actions.description: Fetch an actor from the Analyst1 platform by its Analyst1 ID
Fetch a malware family from the Analyst1 platform by its Analyst1 ID
Upload file from vault to Analyst1 as evidence file

evidence_file_classification.name: evidence_file_classification
evidence_file_classification.description: The evidence file's classification. Only used if a classification can not be determined during extraction.

tlp.name: tlp
tlp.description: The evidence file's traffic light protocol (TLP) designation. Only used if a TLP can not be determined during extraction.

source_id.name: source_id
source_id.description: The evidence file's source ID number.

source_title.name: source_title
source_title.description: The evidence file's source name. If included, an exact match search will run against Analyst1's Evidence Sources. If a match is found that Source will be assigned this created Evidence. The Name is used second (2nd) in Source discovery order. If no Source discovery method is provided (ID, Name, or URL) then the Source will be 'Unknown' on the Evidence created.

source_url.name: source_url
source_url.description: The evidence file's source URL. If included, all REGEX values defined for Evidence Sources will be compared. If a match is found the Source will be assgined this created Evidence. The URL is used third (3rd) in Source discovery order. If no Source discovery method is provided (ID, Name, or URL) then the Source will be 'Unknown' on the Evidence created.

disable_indicator_auto_enrichment.name: disable_indicator_auto_enrichment
disable_indicator_auto_enrichment.description: Influences Indicator automated enrichment during ingest. Default (false) is to allow enrichment. Caller may override and disable automated enrichment. Value ignored if Indicator Auto Enrichment is not enabled in this Analyst1's Admin Controls.

actions.description: Check the status of an evidence file upload
Browse and fetch evidence resources.

page.name: page
page.description: The specific page number to retrieve (1-indexed). If provided, only that single page will be returned. If not provided, all pages will be retrieved up to the specified limit.

desc_sort.name: desc_sort
desc_sort.description: The sort direction. True for a descending sort, false for a ascending sort.

sort_by.name: sort_by
sort_by.description: The value to sort results on. Allowed values are 'id', 'analyzed', 'indicatorsStatus', 'title', 'tlp', 'type', 'exploitStage', 'attackPattern', 'activityDate', 'reportedDate', & 'assignedTo'.

type.name: type
type.description: Filter results based on evidence type. Allowed values are 'pcap', 'image', 'pdf', 'txt', 'web', 'incident_04', 'stix', 'caseType', 'spreadsheet', 'doc', 'ppt', 'xml', & 'other'.

indicators_verified_date_from.name: indicators_verified_date_from
indicators_verified_date_from.description: Filter results based on indicators verified date after (including) this provided date in ISO-8601 format.

indicators_verified_date_to.name: indicators_verified_date_to
indicators_verified_date_to.description: Filter results based on indicators verified date before (including) this provided date in ISO-8601 format.

analyzed_date_from.name: analyzed_date_from
analyzed_date_from.description: Filter results based on analyzed date after (including) this provided date in ISO-8601 format.

analyzed_date_to.name: analyzed_date_to
analyzed_date_to.description: Filter results based on analyzed date before (including) this provided date in ISO-8601 format.

nominated_for_incident.name: nominated_for_incident
nominated_for_incident.description: Filter results based on Nominated for Incident Response State.

nominated_for_report.name: nominated_for_report
nominated_for_report.description: Filter results based on Nominated for Report State.

actions.description: Browse and fetch sensors from the Analyst1 platform

page.name: page
page.description: The specific page number to retrieve (1-indexed). If provided, only that single page will be returned. If not provided, all pages will be retrieved up to a 10 page limit.

page_size.name: page_size
page_size.description: The number of sensors to return per page.

type.name: type
type.description: Filter results based on sensor type.

org.name: org
org.description: Filter results based on the sensor's organization ID.

logical_location.name: logical_location
logical_location.description: Filter results based on the sensor's logical location.

desc_sort.name: desc_sort
desc_sort.description: The sort direction. True for a descending sort, false for a ascending sort.

sort_by.name: sort_by
sort_by.description: The value to sort results on.

actions.description: Fetch the indicators and rules currently tasked to an Analyst1 sensor
Fetch an Analyst1 sensor's current configuration file and store it in the vault
Fetch the tasking differences between an Analyst1 sensor config version and the latest version

version.name: version
version.description: The sensor config version to diff against the latest version
